pages.title: Following a Branch
pages.text: Solid lines connect a branch to its children. Dashed lines show cross-tree prerequisites, including those that unlock a synergy. Select a related node to brighten its connections.$(br2)When a prerequisite is collapsed, its connection follows the nearest visible ancestor. Expanding the branch reconnects the line to the actual prerequisite.

pages.title: Building Together
pages.text: A synergy can require progress in several trees without merging their points. Its details show the complete purchase price.$(br2)Use the details panel to enable or disable purchased upgrades. Turning off a parent leaves its descendants available. Choose modifiers that fit your spell's current slot limit.

pages.title: Purchase More Ranks
pages.text: Hold a node to buy another rank. After 100 ms by default, it shakes and fills while the dings rise in pitch; a completion sound confirms the purchase.$(br2)Children appear once their required parent ranks and other prerequisites are met. Each new rank pays the listed costs.

pages.title: Shared Prerequisites
pages.text: Prerequisites can combine AND and OR groups. A tree stops leveling once its point awards cover all of its ranks.
